e.title: Triple-I 核保 AI 人才
e.summary: Triple-I：谁培养明天的核保员——保险业 AI 人才难题
e.body: Triple-I（美国保险信息协会）「Who Trains Tomorrow's Underwriters? Insurers' AI Talent Puzzle」：核保员的 AI 人才难题分析——AI 时代的核保人才培养。对 RIAA：核保人才的专业分析——与 [[ai-two-track-workforce]]（双轨劳动力）、[[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）配套：AI 人才的分化/培养；理解「谁培养明天的人才」的行业之问（学校/公司/个人）；求职/培养规划的行业视角。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：Triple-I 官网确认（核保 AI 人才难题文章），未通读
e.title_hk: Triple-I 核保 AI 人才
e.summary_en: Triple-I: who trains tomorrow's underwriters — insurers' AI talent puzzle
e.summary_hk: Triple-I：誰培養明天的核保員——保險業 AI 人才難題
e.body_en: Triple-I (US Insurance Information Institute) 'Who Trains Tomorrow's Underwriters? Insurers' AI Talent Puzzle': an analysis of the AI-talent puzzle for underwriters — cultivating underwriting talent in the AI era. For RIAA: a professional analysis of underwriting talent — with [[ai-two-track-workforce]] (two-track workforce) and [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] (hybrid roles) it frames AI-talent divergence/cultivation; understand the industry question of 'who trains tomorrow's talent' (schools/companies/individuals); an industry view for job/cultivation planning.
e.body_hk: Triple-I（美國保險信息協會）「Who Trains Tomorrow's Underwriters? Insurers' AI Talent Puzzle」：核保員的 AI 人才難題分析——AI 時代的核保人才培養。對 RIAA：核保人才的專業分析——與 [[ai-two-track-workforce]]（雙軌勞動力）、[[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）配套：AI 人才的分化/培養；理解「誰培養明天的人才」的行業之問（學校/公司/個人）；求職/培養規劃的行業視角。
